After a thorough search through their impressive selection, I was delighted to find exactly what I was looking for. Also there were 3 color options available: Shiny Black, Tomato Red and lastly  White.

The staff was exceptionally welcoming. They allowed me to explore the store at my own pace while being readily available to answer all my queries. What truly stood out was their proactive approach—they even offered me a discount upfront. Their fluency in Marathi was an unexpected and pleasant surprise, further enhancing my experience.

The billing process was smooth and efficient, with no unnecessary delays or intrusive requests for personal information. This was greatly appreciated, as it respected my time and privacy.

Now, about the car I purchased—it's a masterpiece. The model is incredibly detailed, with all doors openable. It features two modes:

1. Constant lights-only mode.

2. Engine sound and atomizer mode – activated by pressing the front hood. This mode is especially impressive, as it produces smoke from the lower back of the car, enhanced by a blue light for a captivating visual effect.

Interestingly, I initially planned to buy a large bus as a gift for my youngest sibling but ended up treating myself to this diecast model to expand my collection.

Overall, Toy Mania exceeded all expectations, from its vast collection and customer service to the quality of the products. I highly recommend visiting this shop. Whether you’re a diecast enthusiast or looking for the perfect toy, this place will not disappoint!
